name: La-rel
description: La-rel is a highly magical, Feywild-like realm of Atlas whose inhabitants are relatively unconcerned with the wider world. It is associated with Walker’s past, as it was his former home, and the party has previously visited the realm and encountered Renard, the smiling trickster. La-rel is one of the Atlas realms represented by a keystone, but its keystone remains unassigned.

log.summary: La-rel’s keystone was offered to Walker because of his connection to the realm as his former home and because he is the only party member originally from outside Midgard. Walker declined, explaining that while La-rel is an important part of his past, it no longer defines who he is. The keystone therefore remains unassigned, with Kit Anger and the DM agreeing to steward it until a future keeper takes the mantle.
notes: La-rel is highly magical and essentially Feywild-like, with inhabitants relatively unconcerned with the rest of Atlas.
Walker was offered its keystone because he is the only party member originally from outside Midgard.
Walker declined because La-rel represents an important part of his past but no longer defines who he is.
The party has previously visited La-rel and encountered Renard, the smiling trickster.
Kit Anger and the DM will steward the keystone until a future keeper takes the mantle.
